data.title: Social Security Board election postponement urged
data.description: The People’s Party and a veteran labour leader have called for the Social Security Board election scheduled for Sunday to be postponed because of severe flooding in several parts of the country.

data.title: Agencies team up to provide flood travel updates
data.description: With floods causing transport chaos across Bangkok, authorities are stepping up measures to assist travellers and tourists facing delays in getting to airports and, in some cases, missed flights.

data.title: Free parking at train stations, malls in flooded Bangkok
data.description: Many buildings around Bangkok and surrounding areas are offering free parking for people affected by flooding, including park-and-ride facilities at train stations and garages at shopping malls.

data.title: All 50 Bangkok districts declared disaster areas
data.description: All 50 districts of Bangkok have been declared disaster zones as heavy rain continues to cause flooding, traffic problems and disruptions to daily life.

data.title: Democrats face identity test
data.description: The Democrat Party's decision to take a harder line on the Senate election-fraud case is exposing a potentially costly fault line between its stated commitment to democratic institutions and the political identity of part of its traditional support base.

data.title: Snooker prospects 'at risk'
data.description: Thailand celebrates its snooker champions, but players and lawmakers say gambling regulations are making it harder to train the next generation.

data.title: Amlo to take victims' claims
data.description: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) is preparing to accept claims from victims of alleged investment fraud involving Yim Leak, Benjamin Mauerberger, also known as Ben Smith, and their associates. Assets seized or frozen in the case are now valued at more than 26.337 billion baht.

data.title: BMTA sees EV fleet as ticket to ending losses
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) expects to end its operating losses by 2030 as an electric vehicle (EV) fleet cuts costs and raises efficiency.

data.title: Eastern Bangkok under water
data.description: Eastern Bangkok is heavily flooded. All local canals are full and 15 main roads are deep underwater on Sunday morning, according to Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt.

data.title: Vegetarian Festival in Phuket to net 1.4 billion baht
data.description: Phuket expects this year's Vegetarian Festival to generate at least 1.4 billion baht in economic activity as more than 140,000 visitors are forecast to attend.

data.title: Festival to net B1.4bn
data.description: Phuket expects this year's Vegetarian Festival to generate at least 1.4 billion baht in economic activity as more than 140,000 visitors are forecast to attend.

data.title: New app 'eases' Thai immigration
data.description: Foreign visitors to Thailand will have easier access to immigration and travel services through the newly launched Thai Immigration (THIM) Application, Pol Lt Gen Panumas Boonyalug, Immigration Bureau commissioner, said.

data.title: Spanish chef loses appeal against life sentence
data.description: The Appeal Court has upheld a life sentence for Spanish chef Daniel Sancho Bronchalo for the premeditated murder of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta Arteaga on Koh Phangan.

data.title: Court to rule on ballot barcodes
data.description: Attention is turning to Monday's Constitutional Court ruling on barcodes and QR codes on election ballots, with a former election commissioner outlining four possible outcomes, ranging from no change to a fresh general election.

data.title: Cancer plans face funding shortfall
data.description: HONG KONG: Funding for national cancer control plans remains critically insufficient, with fewer than 10% fully funded worldwide, the president of the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC) has warned.

data.title: Court upholds ruling disqualifying NBTC chairman
data.description: The Central Administrative Court upheld a ruling disqualifying National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck from office, finding that his work at a state-run hospital breached eligibility rules.

data.title: Court acquits iCon founder ‘Boss Paul’ in money-laundering case
data.description: The Criminal Court acquitted The iCon Group founder and CEO Warathaphon “Boss Paul” Waratyaworrakul, politician Samart Janechaijittawanich and his mother, Wilawan Phutthasamrit, of charges of colluding to launder 2.5 million baht from the direct-sales company.

data.title: Dozens of Bangkok streets flooded amid non-stop rain
data.description: Dozens of Bangkok roads were flooded on Friday evening as rain that began on Thursday night persisted through the day, the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration said.

data.title: Hua Hin ready to clear beach after decades-long dispute
data.description: Authorities in Hua Hin are stepping up their efforts to clear all houses and buildings encroaching on a public beach to resolve a decades-long dispute, in the face of defiance from some owners.

data.title: Retired general’s son sets house ablaze, takes own life
data.description: The son of a retired army general took his own life after setting fire to his home and shooting at firefighters before police could enter to discover a huge cache of military-grade weapons and explosives at his two-storey property in Bang Phlat district of Bangkok on Friday morning.

data.title: PM: Thailand backs UN reform, peaceful approach to Cambodia dispute
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed Thailand's neutral stance and called for reform of the United Nations to ensure all countries have an equal right to participate in shaping the future of the international community.

data.title: Son of ex-Maj Gen set fire to house, attacked rescuers before taking own life
data.description: The son of a retired Maj Gen took his own life after allegedly setting fire to his home and shooting at firefighters before police would discover a cache of military-grade weapons and explosives at his two-storey property in Bangkok’s Bang Phlat district on Friday morning.

data.title: City Hall steps up flood fight in eastern Bangkok
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is focusing its flood-control efforts on the eastern part of the capital for the rest of the day and has warned city residents of rain throughout Friday.

data.title: Court acquits Boss Paul, two others in 2.5m-baht money-laundering case
data.description: The Criminal Court has acquitted The iCon Group founder and CEO Warathaphon “Boss Paul” Waratyaworrakul, politician Samart Janechaijittawanich and his mother, Wilawan Phutthasamrit, of charges of colluding to launder 2.5 million baht from the direct-sales company.

data.title: Nene's rocky road to stardom
data.description: Nine years ago, a little girl in Phuket overslept. That single, ordinary mistake would eventually lead her to the global stage -- and to becoming one of Thailand's most talked-about young musicians.

data.title: Navy to retire 10 ageing ships from Oct 1
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) will retire 10 vessels from Oct 1 due to deterioration from prolonged service and high maintenance costs.

data.title: GPS trackers for foreign trucks
data.description: Foreign freight vehicles entering Thailand will be required to install GPS tracking devices from Jan 1, 2027, under a measure aimed at improving road safety and strengthening oversight of cross-border transport.

data.title: Panel sounds alarm on teen pregnancies
data.description: Thailand's low birth rate is drawing attention to its ageing population, but unintended pregnancies -- particularly among adolescents -- remain a concern, prompting calls for better sex education and easier access to contraceptive advice.

data.title: Anutin courts US investment
data.description: Thailand is positioning itself as a gateway to Asean's 700 million people, offering US businesses access to regional markets through trade and investment, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said in New York.

data.title: Myanmar recalls ambassador to Thailand for questioning
data.description: Myanmar has recalled its ambassador to Thailand for questioning, reportedly in connection with the transport of migrant workers into the country.

data.title: Ex-minister given death sentence for murder of adopted son
data.description: The Criminal Court has sentenced former cabinet minister Soonthorn Vilawan, 87, to death for the murder of a Prachin Buri councillor who was his adopted son. The sentence was commuted to life imprisonment.

data.title: Chearavanont family gives condo to AGT winner Nene Royal
data.description: Thailand’s second-richest family has given a 98-square-metre luxury condominium to the family of young Thai rocker Nene Royal, who made history on Thursday as the first Thai to win “America’s Got Talent”.

data.title: MP and actor among 34 targeted for forex scam prosecution
data.description: People’s Party MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom Tokongsup are among 34 suspects the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is seeking to indict in a high-profile foreign-exchange scam case.

data.title: Visitor goes missing in flooded Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - A man believed to be a foreigner went missing after his group fell into a canal while they were wading through a flooded alley in this tourist city early Thursday morning.

data.title: Thai students exempt from new Australian visa measures
data.description: Australian authorities have reaffirmed that Thai students will be exempt from new visa measures affecting international students, while seeking closer cooperation with Thailand on trade, migration and regional security.

data.title: DSI head appointment raises PP ire
data.description: The opposition has raised concerns over the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI), warning the agency could be turned into a political tool or used to benefit people facing criminal charges.

data.title: Traffy Fondue to expand its reach across govt agencies
data.description: The Traffy Fondue platform has been adopted as a central government service for reporting and managing urban problems, the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, Yodchanan Wongsawat, said.
